m.s: Toss {chk_breast} with {oregano}, the juice of {lemon*0.5}, {garlic*0.5} (crushed), a little oil and a pinch of salt. Leave for 15 minutes.

Rinse {quinoa} well in a sieve, as it stops it tasting bitter. Simmer in a saucepan with twice its volume of salted water for 12 minutes until the little tails pop out. Take it off the heat, cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Coarsely grate {cucumber*0.5} and squeeze out the water with your hands. Mix with {yoghurt}, the rest of the garlic, chopped {mint}, a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Heat a grill pan or frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes a side until cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Rest, then slice.
Chop {cos}, the rest of the cucumber, {cherrytom} and {red_onion}. Crumble over {fetta} and dress with a squeeze of the remaining lemon and a drizzle of oil.
Divide the quinoa between bowls and top with the salad, chicken and tzatziki.

l: Built for lunch. Tzatziki on the side. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
